dimensions.note: Reviewed at content hash e018da71. report now also reads the runner's collectives and one 'swamp extension search --collective' listing per collective. Only extension names are kept from the listing, and only in the rendered report; nothing new is stored. No secrets are read or logged.
Found: an inventory failure was logged without its cause. Fixed: the warning now carries the error message. report still logs one info line on success.

Probed: whoami failure makes report throw and write no files (tested); a listing failure yields reports marked 'inventory unavailable' with an unknown untracked count rather than zero (tested); an identity with no collectives says so (tested). The listing paginates by 100 and throws if a page adds no names before reaching meta.total, so a short registry page cannot loop forever or claim completeness.
